# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

## Sign up and be the first to know about our exciting innovations.

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

complete support.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and

complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and

## Healthcare solutions for modern day Heroes

[Woman doctor and a mobile flying ambulan]

Estill Medical Technologies is an innovative solutions-driven company, developing and manufacturing
patient temperature management and medical energy solutions.  The leading device produced by Estill,
is the portable Thermal Angel Blood and IV Fluid Infusion warmer (TA-200) powered by our compact yet
rugged military grade battery (UB-1) allowing for warming care to be given in the field immediately
to the patient. We proudly serve the emergency medical community, first responders, military,
government, and university researchers.   Let us know what we can do for you today.

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

# Saving Lives.
# Together.

On the front lines of critical care, everything matters. Lives depend upon us—all of us bringing our
best. Our innovative medical devices help you deliver. Belmont’s solutions blend technical
inspiration with an uncompromising quality standard. Because earning your trust is the only option.

When lives are in your hands, reach for Belmont.

## At our best when it matters most.

In developing and refining our leading fluid warming and temperature regulation devices, we strive
to innovate advanced capabilities and patient safety features that give you the power and precision
to change the course of critical outcomes.
* [ BLOOD & FLUID WARMING ][31]
* [ TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT ][32]
* [ HYPERTHERMIC LAVAGE ][33]

BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### The Belmont^{®} Rapid Infuser RI-2

Trusted in the most extreme situations for more than 20 years, The Belmont® Rapid Infuser delivers
rapid, reliable, and bubble-free delivery of life-saving warmed blood and fluid at the touch of a
button.
* Precise control of fluid delivery (at rates from 2.5 to 1000 ml per minute)
* Precise, high-speed warming
* Automatic air detection and removal
* Intuitive touchscreen display
* Aluminum-free disposables

[LEARN MORE][34]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### buddy lite^{®}

Portable blood and fluid warming—anytime, anywhere—in a remarkably compact, lightweight package,
buddy lite^{®} is used globally by clinicians to help prevent hypothermia during fluid
administration.
* Easy to use
* Close-to-patient warming
* Battery or AC powered
* Military tested and approved
* Aluminum-free disposable

[LEARN MORE][35]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### BloodNav^{™}

MTP Performance Improvement & Automatic Documentation Tool
* Rapidly tracks blood products across all locations
* Calculates ratios to support balanced transfusion goals
* Displays customizable MTP performance improvement prompts
* Provides live web dashboard for blood bank
* Streamlines documentation & integrates with EMRs

[LEARN MORE][36]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### Burn Navigator^{®}

Evidence-based fluid management for severely burned adults and children
* Unique resuscitation graphs
* 24-hour volume projections
* Non-responder detection and alerts
* Customizable protocols
* Inhalation injury guidelines
* EMR connectivity

[LEARN MORE][37]
TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT

### Allon^{®}

Safe, simple, and effective, this non-invasive system maintains patient body temperature throughout
all stages of the perioperative continuum. Allon’s algorithm-driven heat pump circulates water
through the ThermoWrap^{®} disposable patient garment.
* Consistent body temperature control
* Simple, easy-to-use touch-screen interface
* Real-time monitoring and graphical display
* Full range of sizes and configurations

 

[LEARN MORE][38]
TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT

### CritiCool^{®}

Maintaining pre-set, targeted body temperature as determined by a physician, this safe, and
effective system is composed of two elements, the CritiCool device and the CureWrap^{®}.
* Consistent body temperature control
* Simple, easy to use and quick set up
* Real-time monitoring and graphical touch-screen display
* Flexibility and versatility with one-piece body-shaped garments

[LEARN MORE][39]
HYPERTHERMIC LAVAGE

### Hyperthermia Pump^{™}

The Hyperthermia Pump raises the temperature of a patient’s thoracic or peritoneal cavity to the
desired target temperature by continuously lavaging it with warmed sterile solution.
* Precise temperature control
* High-efficiency electromagnetic induction warmer
* Automatic air removal
* Easy-to-use touchscreen
* Aluminum-free disposables

[LEARN MORE][40]

## Areas of Care

In every area of care, better products result in better outcomes. Patients, their advocates, and
your own people expect the best from you. Belmont solutions blend technical inspiration with
uncompromising quality to give your clinicians added power to affect the course of medical events.
That’s the goal we all share.

# Saving Lives.
# Together.

On the front lines of critical care, everything matters. Lives depend upon us—all of us bringing our
best. Our innovative medical devices help you deliver. Belmont’s solutions blend technical
inspiration with an uncompromising quality standard. Because earning your trust is the only option.

When lives are in your hands, reach for Belmont.

## At our best when it matters most.

In developing and refining our leading fluid warming and temperature regulation devices, we strive
to innovate advanced capabilities and patient safety features that give you the power and precision
to change the course of critical outcomes.
* [ BLOOD & FLUID WARMING ][31]
* [ TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT ][32]
* [ HYPERTHERMIC LAVAGE ][33]

BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### The Belmont^{®} Rapid Infuser RI-2

Trusted in the most extreme situations for more than 20 years, The Belmont® Rapid Infuser delivers
rapid, reliable, and bubble-free delivery of life-saving warmed blood and fluid at the touch of a
button.
* Precise control of fluid delivery (at rates from 2.5 to 1000 ml per minute)
* Precise, high-speed warming
* Automatic air detection and removal
* Intuitive touchscreen display
* Aluminum-free disposables

[LEARN MORE][34]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### buddy lite^{®}

Portable blood and fluid warming—anytime, anywhere—in a remarkably compact, lightweight package,
buddy lite^{®} is used globally by clinicians to help prevent hypothermia during fluid
administration.
* Easy to use
* Close-to-patient warming
* Battery or AC powered
* Military tested and approved
* Aluminum-free disposable

[LEARN MORE][35]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### BloodNav^{™}

MTP Performance Improvement & Automatic Documentation Tool
* Rapidly tracks blood products across all locations
* Calculates ratios to support balanced transfusion goals
* Displays customizable MTP performance improvement prompts
* Provides live web dashboard for blood bank
* Streamlines documentation & integrates with EMRs

[LEARN MORE][36]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### Burn Navigator^{®}

Evidence-based fluid management for severely burned adults and children
* Unique resuscitation graphs
* 24-hour volume projections
* Non-responder detection and alerts
* Customizable protocols
* Inhalation injury guidelines
* EMR connectivity

[LEARN MORE][37]
TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT

### Allon^{®}

Safe, simple, and effective, this non-invasive system maintains patient body temperature throughout
all stages of the perioperative continuum. Allon’s algorithm-driven heat pump circulates water
through the ThermoWrap^{®} disposable patient garment.
* Consistent body temperature control
* Simple, easy-to-use touch-screen interface
* Real-time monitoring and graphical display
* Full range of sizes and configurations

 

[LEARN MORE][38]
TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT

### CritiCool^{®}

Maintaining pre-set, targeted body temperature as determined by a physician, this safe, and
effective system is composed of two elements, the CritiCool device and the CureWrap^{®}.
* Consistent body temperature control
* Simple, easy to use and quick set up
* Real-time monitoring and graphical touch-screen display
* Flexibility and versatility with one-piece body-shaped garments

[LEARN MORE][39]
HYPERTHERMIC LAVAGE

### Hyperthermia Pump^{™}

The Hyperthermia Pump raises the temperature of a patient’s thoracic or peritoneal cavity to the
desired target temperature by continuously lavaging it with warmed sterile solution.
* Precise temperature control
* High-efficiency electromagnetic induction warmer
* Automatic air removal
* Easy-to-use touchscreen
* Aluminum-free disposables

[LEARN MORE][40]

## Areas of Care

In every area of care, better products result in better outcomes. Patients, their advocates, and
your own people expect the best from you. Belmont solutions blend technical inspiration with
uncompromising quality to give your clinicians added power to affect the course of medical events.
That’s the goal we all share.

## Featured Products

#### EM-MED TrueCool® Premium

The EM-MED TrueCool® Premium is an advanced targeted temperature management (TTM) device designed
for precise, non-invasive cooling and warming of patients. It features a 10″ touchscreen for
temperature adjustments in 0.05°C increments, supports multiple cooling and warming programs, and
includes high-accuracy sensors with monitoring and data export capabilities, making it suitable for
various clinical conditions such as post-cardiac arrest, brain injury, and neonatal care.

#### Enthermics® Blanket Warming Cabinet, Model EC250

The EC250 is a robust, countertop warming unit designed to keep blankets at precise temperatures
(32–71 °C) using patented WarmSafe™ zone heating and fan-less technology, ensuring quiet, even
warmth that supports patient recovery and reduces surgical site infection risks. Built with a rugged
stainless steel exterior and a white epoxy-coated interior, it holds 4–6 blankets in its 2.5 ft³
chamber and offers optional mobility via heavy-duty casters, plus features like programmable
controls, LED display, and secure magnetic door closure.

#### Action® Patient Positioner

The Action® Patient Positioner is a versatile, pressure-relieving device designed to support
patients during various surgical procedures. Crafted from Akton® polymer, it offers superior comfort
and shear reduction, helping to prevent pressure injuries in clinical settings. Its adaptability
makes it suitable for use in procedures requiring lateral or prone positioning, as well as for
patients with circulatory concerns.

## Featured Products

#### EM-MED TrueCool® Premium

The EM-MED TrueCool® Premium is an advanced targeted temperature management (TTM) device designed
for precise, non-invasive cooling and warming of patients. It features a 10″ touchscreen for
temperature adjustments in 0.05°C increments, supports multiple cooling and warming programs, and
includes high-accuracy sensors with monitoring and data export capabilities, making it suitable for
various clinical conditions such as post-cardiac arrest, brain injury, and neonatal care.

#### Enthermics® Blanket Warming Cabinet, Model EC250

The EC250 is a robust, countertop warming unit designed to keep blankets at precise temperatures
(32–71 °C) using patented WarmSafe™ zone heating and fan-less technology, ensuring quiet, even
warmth that supports patient recovery and reduces surgical site infection risks. Built with a rugged
stainless steel exterior and a white epoxy-coated interior, it holds 4–6 blankets in its 2.5 ft³
chamber and offers optional mobility via heavy-duty casters, plus features like programmable
controls, LED display, and secure magnetic door closure.

#### Action® Patient Positioner

The Action® Patient Positioner is a versatile, pressure-relieving device designed to support
patients during various surgical procedures. Crafted from Akton® polymer, it offers superior comfort
and shear reduction, helping to prevent pressure injuries in clinical settings. Its adaptability
makes it suitable for use in procedures requiring lateral or prone positioning, as well as for
patients with circulatory concerns.

# We’ve got your plan. And your back.

**Had a big life change?** You may be able to get health insurance — and most people get help paying
for it.
[ Get Started ][49]
[ Find Free Local Help ][50]
[
Get a Quick Quote
Browse plans and find one that’s best for your life and budget.

Sign In [button-icon] [button-icon]

Federal Changes to Insurance
Updated June 15, 2026
Here’s what we know about new federal rules and how they may affect your costs and coverage.
See What's Changing [button-icon] [button-icon]
][53]

## Included in Every Plan
* Free Annual Wellness Exam
* Pre-existing Condition Coverage
* Mental Health Care
* Prescription Drug Coverage
* ER and Hospitalization Coverage
* Maternity and Newborn Care
* Free Cancer Screenings
* Option to Add Dental and Vision

## Financial Help Made Easy

Financial help lowers your monthly payment. Your cost will depend on your situation* and plan
choice. The examples below use [Silver][54] coverage level. [Bronze][55], [Gold][56] and
[Platinum][57] plans may cost more or less.

Learn how Covered California works, from financial help to choosing a health plan that fits your
needs.

[ Start Learning ][60]

## WHO ARE WE?

At Croyde Medical, our mission and vision statements guide how we work every day. They reflect who
we are, what we stand for, and the future we are building together with our customers, partners, and
colleagues.

## Our Mission

We specialise in maternity, neonatal, and temperature management equipment solutions, helping
healthcare teams create exceptional environments to deliver safe, effective, and compassionate care.
Our customers trust us to deliver our promise with support from our field-based specialists and
dedicated customer service team.

## Our Vision

To be the partner of choice for maternity, neonatal, and temperature management equipment. We will
expand our portfolio with clear purpose through innovation and meaningful partnerships, while
building a trusted, responsible brand where our people thrive, our customers feel supported, and we
enjoy the journey together.

## OUR VALUES

Our core values guide us in our mission of helping transform clinical environments. They remind us
of why we started, keep us focused on our goals, and inspire us to continue to help our customers.

[Values Image]

### EXCELLENCE

We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do.

### MAKING A DIFFERENCE

Our products and services make a real difference to healthcare teams and those they care for.

### CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

We constantly evolve, learn, and improve to deliver better outcomes and solutions.

### AGILITY

We are responsive and adaptable, reacting quickly to our customers' needs.

### TRUST FIRST

We build long-lasting, trusted relationships with our suppliers, partners and customers.

## YOU'RE SAFE IN OUR HANDS

Croyde Medical is a NHSSC framework approved supplier and has been trading with the NHS for 10
years.

We are also an ISO 9001 accredited organisation, which means we adhere to the highest standards of
quality management. This accreditation gives our customers the confidence to work with us, knowing
that they will receive reliable, top-notch service and products that meet stringent industry
standards.

**188**

**68,641**

kids hospitalised with an injury every year

## Our mission is
## every parent’s mission

We are a charity on a mission to reduce the incidence and
impact of a child’s critical injury.

With your support, we have **already contributed nearly
$2,000,000 worth of research**
to determine how to do that.

Our campaigns respond directly to recommendations
from this research.  That’s why we know they’ll work.

### We’re raising funds for families.

Help us raise $100,000 to pay for two specialist professionals to care directly
for families at Lady Cilento Children’s Hospital in Brisbane.

[Fundraise][30]

### Reducing the impact

When a child is suddenly critically injured, worlds are turned upside down in shock and panic.
 We’ve discovered two direct support roles in hospital will significantly reduce the impact of a
child’s critical injury.

The Day of Difference Foundation is now funding these two roles at Lady Cilento Children’s Hospital.

[Learn More][31]

### Reducing the Incidence

We have to radically reduce the staggering numbers of children’s injuries in Australia.  More
children are hospitalised with an injury in Australia than diabetes, asthma and cancer combined.

Our partnerships use the information we’ve gathered through research to begin to make a dent in
these numbers.

[Learn More][32]

Learn more about the major fundraising event for the Day of Difference Foundation in 2017

[Check Out Distance for a Difference Tour 2017][33]

Dear Colleagues and Contributors,

We sincerely appreciate your continued interest and support for Neurospine.

We thank you for your understanding and look forward to receiving your valuable research.

**Important Notice: Adjustment of Article Processing Charge (APC)**

Dear Colleagues and Contributors,

We sincerely appreciate your continued interest and support for Neurospine.

To support the sustainable open-access publication of high-quality research, we would like to inform
you of an update to our Article Processing Charge (APC) policy.

Effective for manuscripts **submitted on or after March 1, 2026**, the APC will be adjusted as
follows:
* **Effective Date:** March 1, 2026
* **New APC: USD 700** (payable upon acceptance)
* **Note:** Discounts or waivers will continue to apply to eligible contributors in accordance with
  our existing policy.

We thank you for your understanding and look forward to receiving your valuable research.

Sincerely,
**Inbo Han, MD, PhD Editor-in-Chief, Neurospine**

# Linking You
# to Healthcare Innovations

Trusted provider of premium medical equipment since 2003

[ Get in Touch ][49]
* Who We Are

We are a trusted distributor of medical equipment and laboratory supplies, based in Singapore. We
strive to bring the best in products to hospitals and laboratories in Singapore through partnerships
with world renowned companies.

Established in 2003, we have built a strong presence in the healthcare industry. The solutions we
supply support the diagnostic and therapeutic capabilities of healthcare institutions, helping
clinicians deliver reliable and effective patient care.

[ Know More About Us ][50]

### Core Principles

**Our Vision:** To improve the diagnosis and treatment capabilities of healthcare professionals in
our community.

### Corporate Social Responsibility

Since 2007, we have funded CSR initiatives, including loaning medical equipment for mission trips.

### Technical Service

Rated as **‘Excellent’** by a minimum of 70% of customers who experienced our service, in every
Quarter since 2015.
* Our Partners

[ Distribute With Fortuna ][51]
* Featured Products
‹
›
[Vscan Air SL Handheld Ultrasound]
[Portrait VSM Vital Signs Monitor]
[Diamond Video Laryngoscope]

## Vscan Air SL Handheld Ultrasound
* Wireless, Pocket-sized, Lightweight, Handheld Ultrasound
* Dual Probe included consists of: Sector Phased Array Probe, 1.6 – 3.7 MHz Linear Array Probe, 3.0
  – 12.0 MHz
* Compatible with latest Android phones and tablets (with OS version 11, 12, 13 or newer)

[Enquire About This Product][52]

## Portrait VSM Vital Signs Monitor
* Versatile Monitoring: Configurable for spot-checking or continuous monitoring.
* Broad Patient Compatibility: Suitable for adult, pediatric, and neonatal use.
* Advanced NIBP Technology: Utilizes GE HealthCare’s renowned DINAMAP technology for non-invasive
  blood pressure measurement.

[Enquire About This Product][53]

## Diamond Video Laryngoscope
* Large 3.5” TFT Touchscreen Display: Clear, bright visuals for optimal airway assessment.
* Rotatable Touchscreen: 270° horizontal and 140° vertical rotation, aiding intubation from multiple
  angles.
* High-Definition CMOS Camera with bright white LED illumination.

[Enquire About This Product][54]

### Laboratory Products

As your trusted partner in Singapore’s laboratories, we provide advanced diagnostic solutions and
precision consumables from global innovators to enhance clinical testing.

[ ][55]

### Medical Equipment

As a leading distributor of medical equipment in Singapore, we strive to bring state-of-the-art
products to hospitals and clinics through partnerships with trusted companies.

[ ][56]

### ECG Electrodes

We supply high-quality Skintact ECG electrodes from Austria, preferred by Singapore hospitals for
diverse applications from Resting ECG to MRI.

THE POWER

 GDLS BRAND FILM

**We Serve Those Who Protect What Matters.**

A trusted partner of forces around the world, we deliver with agility, innovation and exceptional
customer support. Every day, our global team forges ahead into the next era of combat capability,
including autonomy-ready platforms, modern digital architecture and AI-enabled advantages.

That’s why Soldiers and Marines have trusted General Dynamics Land Systems products in the toughest
conditions for decades. We deliver the power to win.

[ Learn More ][36]

### ABOUT GDLS

General Dynamics Land Systems builds the combat vehicles and integrated technologies that give
soldiers a decisive advantage. We design, engineer and sustain advanced tracked and wheeled systems
paired with modern electronic architecture, AI-enabled capabilities and autonomy-ready technology.

From Abrams to LAV, Stryker to AJAX, robotic platforms to software solutions and beyond, our
portfolio delivers proven performance and future-ready modernization for customers around the world.

### Not a career.
### A calling.

Join the people who design, build and advance the systems that protect those who protect us. Our
teams see beyond the horizon, solving problems before they become challenges.

Bring your talent. Bring your purpose.

Let’s shape the future of General Dynamics Land Systems together.

pioneered advanced solutions that have become a standard expectation for consumers. Leveraging this
deep-rooted experience, we continue to invest in next-generation technologies where we develop smart
and reliable solutions that expand what’s possible for both existing and growth markets that we
serve.

Our heating technologies use conductive, convective and radiant methods to deliver advanced thermal
solutions that enhance comfort, safety and performance across industries.

Our cooling and ventilation technologies redefine the industry with intelligent airflow systems that
optimize energy efficiency, comfort and customer needs.

Our pneumatic massage systems are powered by first to market Shape Memory Alloy (SMA) valve
technology and deliver ultra-compact, energy-efficient comfort with scientifically optimized pulse
patterns and lifelike massage experiences for wellness, recovery and relaxation across any
environment.

Our advanced valve systems feature Shape Memory Alloy (SMA) actuation and precision injection
molding, which deliver lightweight, modular and energy-efficient solutions for fuel management,
engine control, braking performance and thermal regulation across conventional, hybrid and electric
vehicles.

Our heating technologies use conductive, convective and radiant methods to deliver advanced thermal
solutions that enhance comfort, safety and performance across industries.

Our cooling and ventilation technologies redefine the industry with intelligent airflow systems that
optimize energy efficiency, comfort and customer needs.

Our pneumatic massage systems are powered by first to market Shape Memory Alloy (SMA) valve
technology and deliver ultra-compact, energy-efficient comfort with scientifically optimized pulse
patterns and lifelike massage experiences for wellness, recovery and relaxation across any
environment.

Our advanced valve systems feature Shape Memory Alloy (SMA) actuation and precision injection
molding, which deliver lightweight, modular and energy-efficient solutions for fuel management,
engine control, braking performance and thermal regulation across conventional, hybrid and electric
vehicles.

HotDog utilizes a unique **conductive fabric** called ThermAssure® which emits no waste heat.
Forced-air warming systems have been shown to contaminate the air of the sterile field when their
waste heat carries foreign particles to the surgical site.

Warm from **above** and **below** the patient at the same time. HotDog is the only technology with

## Why Should You Use Air-Free Patient Warming and Grounding?

### [OR Today: Augustine Surgical Combines Patient Warming with Electrosurgical Grounding][90]

“Augustine Surgical’s entire HotDog [Patient] Warming Mattress is now also a return electrode, a
required component in electrosurgery that is performed in roughly 4 out of 5 surgeries…Reusable
capacitive return electrodes have been used for 20-plus years in more than 100 million procedures,
however, this is the first time this function has been combined with active patient warming.” [Read
more about warming and grounding][91]

### [Outpatient Surgery: Managing the Risks of Waste Heat in the OR][92]

“Recent research has revealed that even if smoke evacuation is utilized, surgeons, anesthetists and
the entire OR staff are still at risk of inhaling the viruses and carcinogens contained in surgical
smoke. Why is this the case? The culprit is rising waste heat from commonly used hot-air
patient-warming devices.” [Read more about waste heat][93]

### [Outpatient Surgery: Hypothermia is a Concern in Robotic Surgeries][94]

“The relationship between robotic surgery and inadvertent perioperative hypothermia is the subject
of increased investigation. Minimally invasive robotic surgeries were assumed to provide less risk
of losing normothermia than traditional open surgeries, but that assumption has been called into
question.” [Read more about hypothermia in robotics][95]

“During Surgery, active patient warming is important because of the potential for the patient to
lose heat. There are multiple actors that can affect a patient’s core body temperature during
surgery. Conduction heat loss occurs when heat is transferred through physical contact with an
object, such as a cold operating table.” [Read more about resistive warmers][97]

## Why Should You Use Air-Free Patient Warming and Grounding?

### [OR Today: Augustine Surgical Combines Patient Warming with Electrosurgical Grounding][90]

“Augustine Surgical’s entire HotDog [Patient] Warming Mattress is now also a return electrode, a
required component in electrosurgery that is performed in roughly 4 out of 5 surgeries…Reusable
capacitive return electrodes have been used for 20-plus years in more than 100 million procedures,
however, this is the first time this function has been combined with active patient warming.” [Read
more about warming and grounding][91]

### [Outpatient Surgery: Managing the Risks of Waste Heat in the OR][92]

“Recent research has revealed that even if smoke evacuation is utilized, surgeons, anesthetists and
the entire OR staff are still at risk of inhaling the viruses and carcinogens contained in surgical
smoke. Why is this the case? The culprit is rising waste heat from commonly used hot-air
patient-warming devices.” [Read more about waste heat][93]

### [Outpatient Surgery: Hypothermia is a Concern in Robotic Surgeries][94]

“The relationship between robotic surgery and inadvertent perioperative hypothermia is the subject
of increased investigation. Minimally invasive robotic surgeries were assumed to provide less risk
of losing normothermia than traditional open surgeries, but that assumption has been called into
question.” [Read more about hypothermia in robotics][95]

“During Surgery, active patient warming is important because of the potential for the patient to
lose heat. There are multiple actors that can affect a patient’s core body temperature during
surgery. Conduction heat loss occurs when heat is transferred through physical contact with an
object, such as a cold operating table.” [Read more about resistive warmers][97]

# With you every step of the way

Climbing the mountain of medical device development? Inventors, startups, and established companies
all face distinct development and regulatory challenges along the way. That’s where we come in.

With you every step of the way, or just over the hurdle to a critical milestone, it’s your choice.
We’ll help get you there.

[Contact Us Today][43]

##### Watch Our Medical Device Webinar: MedTech Crossroads

##### Development/Testing

Our developers can help solve your design problems and ensure your product meets its requirements.

##### Intellectual Property

Our experienced team can assist you in the process of developing your ideas and building your
intellectual property.

##### Regulatory Clearance

We can guide you through testing protocols, design requirements, and regulatory processes.

##### Project Rescue

Should a problem arise, allow us to help you get back on track.

About Us

## An Excellent Partner

You know the product. You know the science. We know the development process, the manufacturing
process, and the regulatory process. Since 2010, our team has helped clients reach their
development, prototyping, and regulatory goals. With over 175 clients served, dozens of
first-in-human prototypes fielded, and an established track record of handling novel FDA
submissions, in2being can help you reach your next milestone!

# With you every step of the way

Climbing the mountain of medical device development? Inventors, startups, and established companies
all face distinct development and regulatory challenges along the way. That’s where we come in.

With you every step of the way, or just over the hurdle to a critical milestone, it’s your choice.
We’ll help get you there.

[Contact Us Today][43]

##### Watch Our Medical Device Webinar: MedTech Crossroads

##### Development/Testing

Our developers can help solve your design problems and ensure your product meets its requirements.

##### Intellectual Property

Our experienced team can assist you in the process of developing your ideas and building your
intellectual property.

##### Regulatory Clearance

We can guide you through testing protocols, design requirements, and regulatory processes.

##### Project Rescue

Should a problem arise, allow us to help you get back on track.

About Us

## An Excellent Partner

You know the product. You know the science. We know the development process, the manufacturing
process, and the regulatory process. Since 2010, our team has helped clients reach their
development, prototyping, and regulatory goals. With over 175 clients served, dozens of
first-in-human prototypes fielded, and an established track record of handling novel FDA
submissions, in2being can help you reach your next milestone!

[**More** About in2being][44]

# Welcome to Medbidding

Medbidding is a reliable shopping platform where secondhand medical products are sold. Thanks to
Medbidding, which brings buyers and sellers together, you can buy or sell medical products at the
prices you want.

Becoming a member, adding ads and bidding is free.

The Secure Payment System protects the rights of both parties by securing the buyer’s payment and
the seller’s product. No additional fees, full assurance.

## Search

Search

## **Buy**

You can buy products at the prices you want.
* We provide price assurance. We do not allow unrealistic prices by checking ads. We try to keep
  prices within a reasonable range.
* We offer free technical expertise service. All products you purchase are checked and reported by
  our expert engineers before delivery.
* If you need, you can take advantage of our services such as transportation, installation, training
  and support, paid or free.
* With the Secure Payment System, we protect the rights of both buyers and sellers. Your money and
  property are safe. No additional fees, full assurance.

You can sell products at the prices you want.

  price suggestions suitable for the market. Thus, we provide fast sales at the right price.
* With our technical services, you have the opportunity to sell your idle secondhand medical devices
  at current market prices.
* You can easily sign up to the platform in 10 seconds. The process of adding and editing ads is

[ Contact Us ][12]

## Download Product Catalogue PDF

[ Download Product Catalogue PDF ][13]

## We are Your UK Normothermia Experts

#### Air-Free

HotDog utilizes a unique conductive fabric called ThermAssure® which emits no waste heat. Forced-air
warming systems contaminate the air of the sterile field when their waste heat carries particles to
the surgical site.

#### Better Warming

Warm from above and below the patient at the same time. HotDog is the only technology with both
blankets and mattresses. This gives it tremendous versatility and effectiveness for many procedures.

#### Cost Effective

Implement HotDog with no up-front costs and immediate cost savings. Decrease your cost of care.
Normothermic patients have better outcomes which lead to shorter hospital stays and faster operating
room turnover rates.

## Download ABC Air-Free, Conductive Patient Warming Catalogue PDF

[ Download ABC Catalogue PDF ][14]

## Available Via The Patient Temperature Management Framework On NHS Supply Chain & NHS Scotland

## Temperature Management Controllers

#### The most advanced temperature management system ever developed

[ Find out more ][15]

## WaffleGrip® Trendelenburg Patient Positioner

#### The ONLY effective warming solution for Trendelenburg position

[ Find out more ][16]

## Patient Warming Blanket

#### Easy to use for every surgical position

[ Find out more ][17]

## Patient Warming Mattresses

#### Warm from above and below simultaneously

[ Find out more ][18]

## What is HotDog?

HotDog Patient Warming is an air-free, water-free, perioperative temperature management system. A
central temperature management controller sends low-voltage current to up to 5 warming devices.
Efficient warming is then delivered by a flexible, lightweight conductive polymer fabric inside of
HotDog blankets and mattresses. This fabric performs resistive warming, which is much safer than
other warming systems. It’s the only patient warming system that warms the patient from above and
below simultaneously. This results in a uniquely versatile, less expensive, and more effective
warming solution before, during, and after surgery.
[ Contact Us ][19]

## Download Best PDF

[ Download Best Catalogue PDF ][20]

## Why Should You Use Air-Free Patient Warming?

#### Managing the Risks of Waste Heat in the Operating Theatre

“Recent research has revealed that even if smoke evacuation is utilised, surgeons, anesthetists and
the entire OR staff are still at risk of inhaling the viruses and carcinogens contained in surgical
smoke. Why is this the case? The culprit is rising waste heat from commonly used hot-air
patient-warming devices.”

## Download Waste Heat Catalogue PDF

[ Download Waste Heat Catalogue PDF ][21]

## Patient Warming UK – Sustainability Policy

At Patient Warming UK, sustainability is not just a commitment; it’s our guiding principle. We
prioritise environmental responsibility by integrating sustainable practices into every aspect of
our operations. From sourcing materials with minimal ecological impact to implementing
energy-efficient manufacturing processes, we strive to minimise our carbon footprint. Moreover, we
prioritise the well-being of our communities by supporting local initiatives and fostering a culture
of environmental stewardship among our employees. Through continuous innovation and collaboration,
we aim to create products that promote health, preserve resources, and contribute to a more
sustainable future for generations to come.

## Patient Warming System for Optimising Outcomes

[ Contact Us ][12]

## Download Product Catalogue PDF

[ Download Product Catalogue PDF ][13]

## We are Your UK Normothermia Experts

#### Air-Free

HotDog utilizes a unique conductive fabric called ThermAssure® which emits no waste heat. Forced-air
warming systems contaminate the air of the sterile field when their waste heat carries particles to
the surgical site.

#### Better Warming

Warm from above and below the patient at the same time. HotDog is the only technology with both
blankets and mattresses. This gives it tremendous versatility and effectiveness for many procedures.

#### Cost Effective

Implement HotDog with no up-front costs and immediate cost savings. Decrease your cost of care.
Normothermic patients have better outcomes which lead to shorter hospital stays and faster operating
room turnover rates.

## Download ABC Air-Free, Conductive Patient Warming Catalogue PDF

[ Download ABC Catalogue PDF ][14]

## Available Via The Patient Temperature Management Framework On NHS Supply Chain & NHS Scotland

## Temperature Management Controllers

#### The most advanced temperature management system ever developed

[ Find out more ][15]

## WaffleGrip® Trendelenburg Patient Positioner

#### The ONLY effective warming solution for Trendelenburg position

[ Find out more ][16]

## Patient Warming Blanket

#### Easy to use for every surgical position

[ Find out more ][17]

## Patient Warming Mattresses

#### Warm from above and below simultaneously

[ Find out more ][18]

## What is HotDog?

HotDog Patient Warming is an air-free, water-free, perioperative temperature management system. A
central temperature management controller sends low-voltage current to up to 5 warming devices.
Efficient warming is then delivered by a flexible, lightweight conductive polymer fabric inside of
HotDog blankets and mattresses. This fabric performs resistive warming, which is much safer than
other warming systems. It’s the only patient warming system that warms the patient from above and
below simultaneously. This results in a uniquely versatile, less expensive, and more effective
warming solution before, during, and after surgery.
[ Contact Us ][19]

## Download Best PDF

[ Download Best Catalogue PDF ][20]

## Why Should You Use Air-Free Patient Warming?

#### Managing the Risks of Waste Heat in the Operating Theatre

“Recent research has revealed that even if smoke evacuation is utilised, surgeons, anesthetists and
the entire OR staff are still at risk of inhaling the viruses and carcinogens contained in surgical
smoke. Why is this the case? The culprit is rising waste heat from commonly used hot-air
patient-warming devices.”

## Download Waste Heat Catalogue PDF

[ Download Waste Heat Catalogue PDF ][21]

## Patient Warming UK – Sustainability Policy

At Patient Warming UK, sustainability is not just a commitment; it’s our guiding principle. We
prioritise environmental responsibility by integrating sustainable practices into every aspect of
our operations. From sourcing materials with minimal ecological impact to implementing
energy-efficient manufacturing processes, we strive to minimise our carbon footprint. Moreover, we
prioritise the well-being of our communities by supporting local initiatives and fostering a culture
of environmental stewardship among our employees. Through continuous innovation and collaboration,
we aim to create products that promote health, preserve resources, and contribute to a more
sustainable future for generations to come.

# Recognized as One of the Nation’s Leading Law Firms

[schmidt-firm-sign1]The Schmidt Firm PLLC has been recognized as one of the nation’s leading
plaintiff’s law firms and handles cases in all 50 states. The Firm, over the years, has handled many
types of cases including medical malpractice, nursing home abuse, and transportation accidents.  The
Firm currently handles cases primarily in the areas of Mass Tort drug litigation, catastrophic
trucking accidents, and wrongful death cases.

Attorney CL Mike Schmidt has been practicing law for 50 years.  Starting as a defense lawyer and
moving to the Plaintiff’s side around 1990, he has a full understanding of both sides of the legal
spectrum. He has received a long list of honors and is Board Certified in Civil and Personal Injury
Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and Board Certified as Civil Trial Specialist
by the National Board of Trial Advocacy.

[Scale Icon]

### Nationally Recognized

The Schmidt Firm, PLLC has been recognized as one of the nation’s leading plaintiffs’ law firms and
handles cases in all 50 states. We are very proud of our legal achievements, but equally
self-respecting of our firm’s reputation for providing personal attention to each and every client
we represent.

No matter what type of case you have, you may contact us with confidence by filling out the email
contact form by clicking here or calling us directly by dialing toll free 24 hrs/day (866) 920-0753.

[Gavel Icon]

### A Diversified Practice

The Schmidt Firm, PLLC has focused its practice on the representation of plaintiffs involved in both
traditional personal injury and wrongful death litigation – involving medical malpractice,
transportation accidents and nursing home abuse – as well as mass tort and toxic tort litigation –
involving defective or dangerous pharmaceuticals, medical devices and toxic substances like Benzene
and Asbestos. The Firm has also handled a large number of business cases, for both plaintiffs and
defendants, as well as built one of the nations most preeminent Oil & Gas litigation practices.

[Law Icon]

# Recognized as One of the Nation’s Leading Law Firms

[schmidt-firm-sign1]The Schmidt Firm PLLC has been recognized as one of the nation’s leading
plaintiff’s law firms and handles cases in all 50 states. The Firm, over the years, has handled many
types of cases including medical malpractice, nursing home abuse, and transportation accidents.  The
Firm currently handles cases primarily in the areas of Mass Tort drug litigation, catastrophic
trucking accidents, and wrongful death cases.

Attorney CL Mike Schmidt has been practicing law for 50 years.  Starting as a defense lawyer and
moving to the Plaintiff’s side around 1990, he has a full understanding of both sides of the legal
spectrum. He has received a long list of honors and is Board Certified in Civil and Personal Injury
Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and Board Certified as Civil Trial Specialist
by the National Board of Trial Advocacy.

[Scale Icon]

### Nationally Recognized

The Schmidt Firm, PLLC has been recognized as one of the nation’s leading plaintiffs’ law firms and
handles cases in all 50 states. We are very proud of our legal achievements, but equally
self-respecting of our firm’s reputation for providing personal attention to each and every client
we represent.

No matter what type of case you have, you may contact us with confidence by filling out the email
contact form by clicking here or calling us directly by dialing toll free 24 hrs/day (866) 920-0753.

[Gavel Icon]

### A Diversified Practice

The Schmidt Firm, PLLC has focused its practice on the representation of plaintiffs involved in both
traditional personal injury and wrongful death litigation – involving medical malpractice,
transportation accidents and nursing home abuse – as well as mass tort and toxic tort litigation –
involving defective or dangerous pharmaceuticals, medical devices and toxic substances like Benzene
and Asbestos. The Firm has also handled a large number of business cases, for both plaintiffs and
defendants, as well as built one of the nations most preeminent Oil & Gas litigation practices.

[Law Icon]

meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

# Efficient solutions

# for medical care

Sterisets® delivers cost-efficient medical products that optimize hospital workflows and reduce care
expenses. Our in-house, high-volume production ensures reliability, quality, and competitive
pricing.

# Production

**Independent. Integrated. Invested in Quality.**

Sterisets® International specializes in the production of high-quality, single-use medical
products—with a strong focus on increasing efficiency across the healthcare sector.

With three advanced production facilities in Europe, we operate independently and flexibly. This
allows us to maintain full control over both quality and costs.

We’ve made significant investments in:
* Skilled teams and quality assurance systems;
* Cutting-edge machinery, including injection molding, syringe filling and inspection, lamination,
  and packaging;
* Expanded facilities to support high-volume manufacturing.

Our vertically integrated production strategy ensures control over the entire supply chain—reducing
reliance on third-party suppliers and ensuring product consistency, cost-efficiency, and faster lead
times.

About company TahatAksi

TahatAksi is a family-owned company incorporated in 1994 in Minsk, Belarus. The company has
established itself as a fast-growing manufacturer of medical equipment, specializing in hypothermia
prevention and treatment systems and equipment for both newborns and adults. TahatAksi produces a
range of medical devices, including warming systems for infants, patient warming systems, blood and
infusion warmers, blood and plasma thawers, and warming cabinets for medical fluids and blankets.

Hospital equipment manufacturing company TahatAksi is recognized for its commitment to quality,
implementing a Total Quality Control System that is certified under EN ISO 9001:2015 and EN ISO
13485:2016 standards. Our TAHAT products have also received CE certification, ensuring compliance
with European medical device regulations. TahatAksi serves over 35 countries worldwide and is known
for its focus on creating cost-effective, advanced solutions that meet the demands of healthcare
professionals.

Areas of care
TahatAksi offers advanced solutions in several key medical fields, focusing on improving patient
care and treatment through qualitative high-quality equipment. Manufacturing hospital equipment
include:
* Prevention and Treatment of Hypothermia
  TahatAksi manufactures warming systems for newborns and adults to prevent inadvertent hypothermia
  during perioperative periods or critical and intensive care. These include portable and stationary
  devices to maintain patients’ core body temperature effectively.
* Infant Care
  TAHAT manufactures newborn warming systems, such as the RAMONAK series, designed to ensure thermal
  support for infants in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) and maternity and obstetrics clinics
  and hospitals.
* Blood and Infusion Solutions Warming
  TahatAksi offers a variety of blood and fluid warming devices, including the AMPIR-01 and
  AMPIRMini series, which ensure that IV fluids and blood products are safely warmed before infusion
  into patients, reducing risks associated with cold infusions. Healthcare facilities looking to buy
  medical equipment for safe infusions will find these solutions critical.
* Medical Warming Cabinets
  Our THERMO cabinets are designed to warm medical fluids, blankets, and other materials, ensuring
  they are prepared for use in various medical settings. These cabinets are a staple in the
  company's distribution of medical equipment, providing reliable thermal management.
* Plasma Thawing Devices
  The PlasmaBox thawing device is used for safe and efficient thawing of blood and plasma, as well
  as other plasma products, making it an essential tool in transfusion and emergency care units and
  blood banks. Clinics seeking to buy medical equipment for safe plasma handling will benefit from
  this innovative solution.
* Our mission
  TahatAksi's mission of production of medical equipment is to improve patient care through
  innovative, reliable, and cost-effective medical equipment. The company is dedicated to enhancing
  health outcomes by providing high-quality products that meet the rigorous demands of healthcare
  professionals globally, with a focus on safety, efficiency, and patient comfort.

About company TahatAksi

TahatAksi is a family-owned company incorporated in 1994 in Minsk, Belarus. The company has
established itself as a fast-growing manufacturer of medical equipment, specializing in hypothermia
prevention and treatment systems and equipment for both newborns and adults. TahatAksi produces a
range of medical devices, including warming systems for infants, patient warming systems, blood and
infusion warmers, blood and plasma thawers, and warming cabinets for medical fluids and blankets.

Hospital equipment manufacturing company TahatAksi is recognized for its commitment to quality,
implementing a Total Quality Control System that is certified under EN ISO 9001:2015 and EN ISO
13485:2016 standards. Our TAHAT products have also received CE certification, ensuring compliance
with European medical device regulations. TahatAksi serves over 35 countries worldwide and is known
for its focus on creating cost-effective, advanced solutions that meet the demands of healthcare
professionals.

Areas of care
TahatAksi offers advanced solutions in several key medical fields, focusing on improving patient
care and treatment through qualitative high-quality equipment. Manufacturing hospital equipment
include:
* Prevention and Treatment of Hypothermia
  TahatAksi manufactures warming systems for newborns and adults to prevent inadvertent hypothermia
  during perioperative periods or critical and intensive care. These include portable and stationary
  devices to maintain patients’ core body temperature effectively.
* Infant Care
  TAHAT manufactures newborn warming systems, such as the RAMONAK series, designed to ensure thermal
  support for infants in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) and maternity and obstetrics clinics
  and hospitals.
* Blood and Infusion Solutions Warming
  TahatAksi offers a variety of blood and fluid warming devices, including the AMPIR-01 and
  AMPIRMini series, which ensure that IV fluids and blood products are safely warmed before infusion
  into patients, reducing risks associated with cold infusions. Healthcare facilities looking to buy
  medical equipment for safe infusions will find these solutions critical.
* Medical Warming Cabinets
  Our THERMO cabinets are designed to warm medical fluids, blankets, and other materials, ensuring
  they are prepared for use in various medical settings. These cabinets are a staple in the
  company's distribution of medical equipment, providing reliable thermal management.
* Plasma Thawing Devices
  The PlasmaBox thawing device is used for safe and efficient thawing of blood and plasma, as well
  as other plasma products, making it an essential tool in transfusion and emergency care units and
  blood banks. Clinics seeking to buy medical equipment for safe plasma handling will benefit from
  this innovative solution.
* Our mission
  TahatAksi's mission of production of medical equipment is to improve patient care through
  innovative, reliable, and cost-effective medical equipment. The company is dedicated to enhancing
  health outcomes by providing high-quality products that meet the rigorous demands of healthcare
  professionals globally, with a focus on safety, efficiency, and patient comfort.

### Multiomics Market - Strategic Insights: Analysis 2025 and Forecasts 2033

The multiomics market is booming, projected to reach [estimated 2033 value] by 2033, with a CAGR of
15.26%. This comprehensive analysis explores market drivers, trends, restraints, segmentation
(genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, etc.), key players (Illumina, Thermo Fisher, etc.), and
regional growth, providing valuable insights for investors and industry stakeholders. Recent
developments include: February 2024: Vizzhy Inc. launched the world's inaugural Multiomics Lab in
Bengaluru, India, heralding a major advancement in healthcare innovation. Equipped with cutting-edge
tools and health AI technology, the lab enables physicians to pinpoint root causes and offer
personalized recommendations for their patients.September 2023: MGI, a provider of technology and
tools for life science, introduced the DCS Lab Initiative to stimulate crucial scientific research.
This initiative encourages large-scale multiomics laboratories. Under the initiative, the
organization offers products for numerous applications, including cell omics, DNA sequencing, and
spatial omics based on DNBSEQ technologies, to specified research institutions globally.April 2023:
Biomodal, formerly Cambridge Epigenetix, introduced a new duet multiomics solution that can enable
simultaneous phased reading of epigenetic and genetic information in a single, low-volume sample..
Key drivers for this market are: Rising Demand for Single-cell Multiomics and Advancements in Omics
Technologies, Increasing Investment in Genomics R&D; Growing Demand for Personalized Medicine.
Potential restraints include: Rising Demand for Single-cell Multiomics and Advancements in Omics
Technologies, Increasing Investment in Genomics R&D; Growing Demand for Personalized Medicine.
Notable trends are: The Bulk Multiomics Segment is Expected to Hold the Largest Share of the Market.

The multiomics market is booming, projected to reach [estimated 2033 value] by 2033, with a CAGR of

regional growth, providing valuable insights for investors and industry stakeholders. Recent
developments include: February 2024: Vizzhy Inc. launched the world's inaugural Multiomics Lab in
Bengaluru, India, heralding a major advancement in healthcare innovation. Equipped with cutting-edge
tools and health AI technology, the lab enables physicians to pinpoint root causes and offer
personalized recommendations for their patients.September 2023: MGI, a provider of technology and
tools for life science, introduced the DCS Lab Initiative to stimulate crucial scientific research.
This initiative encourages large-scale multiomics laboratories. Under the initiative, the
organization offers products for numerous applications, including cell omics, DNA sequencing, and
spatial omics based on DNBSEQ technologies, to specified research institutions globally.April 2023:
Biomodal, formerly Cambridge Epigenetix, introduced a new duet multiomics solution that can enable
simultaneous phased reading of epigenetic and genetic information in a single, low-volume sample..

Technologies, Increasing Investment in Genomics R&D; Growing Demand for Personalized Medicine.
Potential restraints include: Rising Demand for Single-cell Multiomics and Advancements in Omics

Our solutions

## How can we help you?

### Operating room

In the operating room, where precision and reliability are paramount, our solutions bring effortless
improvements in care. Our solutions are designed to support surgical teams, with warming devices and
bronchoscopes that ensure patient stability and enhance procedural safety, helping you achieve the
best outcomes in every surgery.

[ Read more ][38]
[ Read more ][39]

### Intensive care unit

Our integrated solutions include advanced temperature management systems, precise fluid and blood
warming devices, and single-use bronchoscopes, all designed to enhance patient care. These solutions
support ICU teams in delivering optimal treatment, improving outcomes, and supporting patient safety
in critical moments.

[ Read more ][40]
[ Read more ][41]

### Emergency department

In the emergency room, rapid and accurate care is crucial. Patient warming technology ensures that
interventions are delivered at optimal temperatures, preventing hypothermia and improving patient
outcomes. This vital solution supports emergency teams by enhancing the efficiency and safety of
critical interventions, ultimately helping to save lives when every second counts.

[ Read more ][42]
[ Read more ][43]

### Bronchoscopy

Broncoflex offers advanced solutions for bronchoscopy with its innovative single-use bronchoscopes.
Designed for precision and ease of use, Broncoflex single use bronchoscopes provide high-quality
visualization and minimize the risk of cross-contamination. Ideal for both diagnostic and
therapeutic procedures, these reliable endoscopes enhance patient safety and efficiency in critical
care and surgical settings.

[ Read more ][44]
[ Read more ][45]

### Urology

In urology, using warmed irrigation fluid enhances patient comfort and maintains normothermia which
reduces the risk of hypothermia during procedures like TURP or cystoscopy. This solution not only
improves patient safety but also ensures smoother, more efficient procedures, especially late in the
list, leading to better overall results in urological care.

[ Read more ][46]
[ Read more ][47]
In the spotlight

## Broncoflex^{®} 5.6/3.0 XFlo

XFlo is the latest addition to the Broncoflex^{®} range, designed with the largest working channel
for its outer diameter to deliver best-in-class suction performance. Tailored to meet the
requirements of pulmonologists, intensivists and anesthesiologists, XFlo combines superior
ergonomics with high efficiency for both diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. Its single-use
design supports infection control by reducing cross-contamination risks while streamlining hospital
workflows and logistics through guaranteed sterility and ease of use.

# Innovation

with purpose
[ Let's connect ][37]
Solu tions

Our solutions

## How can we help you?

### Operating room

In the operating room, where precision and reliability are paramount, our solutions bring effortless
improvements in care. Our solutions are designed to support surgical teams, with warming devices and
bronchoscopes that ensure patient stability and enhance procedural safety, helping you achieve the
best outcomes in every surgery.

[ Read more ][38]
[ Read more ][39]

### Intensive care unit

Our integrated solutions include advanced temperature management systems, precise fluid and blood
warming devices, and single-use bronchoscopes, all designed to enhance patient care. These solutions
support ICU teams in delivering optimal treatment, improving outcomes, and supporting patient safety
in critical moments.

[ Read more ][40]
[ Read more ][41]

### Emergency department

In the emergency room, rapid and accurate care is crucial. Patient warming technology ensures that
interventions are delivered at optimal temperatures, preventing hypothermia and improving patient
outcomes. This vital solution supports emergency teams by enhancing the efficiency and safety of
critical interventions, ultimately helping to save lives when every second counts.

[ Read more ][42]
[ Read more ][43]

### Bronchoscopy

Broncoflex offers advanced solutions for bronchoscopy with its innovative single-use bronchoscopes.
Designed for precision and ease of use, Broncoflex single use bronchoscopes provide high-quality
visualization and minimize the risk of cross-contamination. Ideal for both diagnostic and
therapeutic procedures, these reliable endoscopes enhance patient safety and efficiency in critical
care and surgical settings.

[ Read more ][44]
[ Read more ][45]

### Urology

In urology, using warmed irrigation fluid enhances patient comfort and maintains normothermia which
reduces the risk of hypothermia during procedures like TURP or cystoscopy. This solution not only
improves patient safety but also ensures smoother, more efficient procedures, especially late in the
list, leading to better overall results in urological care.

[ Read more ][46]
[ Read more ][47]
In the spotlight

## Broncoflex^{®} 5.6/3.0 XFlo

XFlo is the latest addition to the Broncoflex^{®} range, designed with the largest working channel
for its outer diameter to deliver best-in-class suction performance. Tailored to meet the
requirements of pulmonologists, intensivists and anesthesiologists, XFlo combines superior
ergonomics with high efficiency for both diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. Its single-use
design supports infection control by reducing cross-contamination risks while streamlining hospital
workflows and logistics through guaranteed sterility and ease of use.

[ Read more ][48] [ Request a trial ][49]
About us

## We are a global leader in the medical industry, committed to support sustainable and accessible
## patient care

Our mission is to drive innovation by creating evidence-based solutions that empower healthcare
professionals to improve patient outcomes. With a bold vision of touching the lives of 25 million
patients annually, we aim to disrupt the healthcare market through agility, integrity, and
reliability. Our commitment to continuous improvement ensures that we not only meet but exceed the
expectations of our partners, patients, and stakeholders, fostering a healthier, more sustainable
future for all.

> Broncoflex® isn’t just a product—it’s a critical part of our success.

Erik Wroblewski ⏺ Anesthesia Manager, Froedtert Hospital

> Broncoflex® by TSC Life has proven to be a reliable solution for pulmonology. Its video

> Spine patients are a huge challenge to keep warm due to their positioning and the necessary

> in critical surgical procedures. Whether in large trauma cases, cardiac surgeries, high-blood-loss
> procedures, or complex oncology operations, this high-flow blood and fluid warmer ensures optimal
> temperature management, reducing the risk of hypothermia and improving patient outcomes. Its
> reliability and ease of use make it an indispensable tool in our operating room, allowing us to
> focus on delivering the best possible care.
